read.thesis: Nextpower (NXT) raised FY26 revenue guidance to $3.425–3.5B and held margins, but Q3 included net project pull-in and capex is modest, so supply discipline is not the story; backlog above $5B is the key support.

capex.quote: Capital expenditures remained modest, resulting in adjusted free cash flow of $119 million in Q3

triggers.label: FY26 revenue guide raised to $3.425–3.5B
triggers.quote: We now expect revenue between $3.425 billion and $3.5 billion, adjusted EBITDA between $810 million and $830 million

triggers.label: Record backlog above $5B
triggers.quote: Backlog now above $5 billion, with “one of our stronger quarters” of new customer bookings, particularly in the US.

triggers.label: Q3 net project pull-in
triggers.quote: On balance, Q3 saw modest net pull-in.

triggers.label: Tariff hit $33M → $44M
triggers.quote: the tariff impact was $44 million, up from $33 million last quarter

guidance.quote: We now expect revenue between $3.425 billion and $3.5 billion
adjusted EBITDA between $810 million and $830 million
adjusted diluted EPS in the range of $4.26 to $4.36
We continue to expect gross margins to be in the low thirties
we're not updating or changing our fiscal 2027 outlook from Capital Markets Day

prior_guidance_check.quote: we're not updating or changing our fiscal 2027 outlook from Capital Markets Day

red_flags.label: Pull-forward revenue in Q3
red_flags.quote: Accelerated project delivery for select customers resulted in pull-forward revenue in Q3

evasions.quote: We're not giving specific attach numbers at this time.
